SITE–001 / FIRST EDITION

This website.

The site itself is a small project: a notebook, a lab, and somewhere to put work that doesn’t need to be a finished portfolio piece.

ON THIS PAGE
The jobThe approachThe trade-offWhat comes next

The job

The game-development portfolio has a clear job: present selected work. This site gives experiments and smaller notes a home of their own.

The approach

Static HTML keeps every page readable without JavaScript. A shared layout and a small build script keep the navigation, content, and page metadata consistent.

The spring study adds a little play to the lab. Its graph is also an actual artifact for the homepage, instead of a decorative background.

The trade-off

A small custom build is easy to inspect, but it doesn’t come with an editor or a large publishing system. For this amount of content, that’s a reasonable constraint. If writing grows, Markdown is the first thing to add.

There are no substitute project screenshots. The archive stays short until there’s real material to put in it.

What comes next

More notes from actual projects, footage from the RFID controller, and a fuller record of changes as the site develops.
